profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.geoLocationName: Wake Forest, North Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
Extensive experience evaluating, integrating and deployment of emerging technologies in new and existing software application and business process. Experienced in: full stack web development, distributed computing, cloud computing, Software as a Service, web UI frameworks and big data. 
Apply extensive software development experience to rapidly evaluating new languages, technologies, development techniques to determine the benefits and challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designer/Developer Bronto Marketing Platform is a cloud-based Software as a Service email marketing provider to the global internet retailer top 1000. 
Design, development, deployment, and monitoring of Commerce REST and gRPC web services. Java based services that store shopping cart status that can be used for marketing to customers. These services leverage the following technologies SpringBoot, Hibernate, MySQL, HBase, Redis, DropWizard, Quartz Scheduler, Mockito, PillowTalk, gRPC. 
Design, development and deployment of JavaScript client that is deployed on a customer’s shopping web site. This client uses CSS selectors to locate DOM nodes to monitor and transmitting shopping cart, product views, and site visits information to the backend REST web services. 
Design, development and deployment of Materal-UI based user interface for configuration of JavaScript client deployed on the customers shopping web site.
Deployment/Monitoring/Support for Commerce Web Services in production environment.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - IBM Mobile Identity
positions.description:
Developer IBM Mobile Identity is a cloud-based Software as a Service cryptographic framework for identity documents. Mobile Identity allows institutions to easily issue digital identity documents, and creates an easy to use system for securely storing and managing those documents on any mobile device. 

Account Management REST Web Service, a Tomcat/MySQL web application running on IBM’s BlueMix. 

Account Management Web User Interface, a HTML5/DOJO dashboard the provides the IBM MI user, issuer, account representative and administrator with intuitive user interface to manage their digital. 

Account Management automated test: Converted manual test cases that were written in word documents to automated test cases using Selenium WebDriver and JUint. This work improved our productivity and code. I also incorporated JaCoCo a Java test coverage tool, to ensure that our test cases where covering 100% of our code paths.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - EclairJS (Open Source Project)
positions.description:
Developer EclairJS is a OpenSource project that exposes the Apache Spark programming model to JavaScript and NodeJS:

EclairJS nashorn  provides a JavaScript Spark API and a JavaScript Spark interpreter (REPL) that converts the JavaScript into an equivalent Java call that wraps the lambda function with an EclairJS Nashorn wrapper such that it can be executed in the JVM via Nashorn on the Spark worker.

EclairJS node is to enable JavaScript/NodeJS developers to program against Apache Spark. EclairJS Node provides an API in NodeJS for the Apache Spark API and a remote client for a node application. EclairJS Node is dependent on the EclairJS Nashorn component.

Integration with IBM BlueMix Apache Spark and IBM BlueMix Object Store Software as a Service cloud offerings.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - Verona Data Visualization
positions.description:
Developer IBM Verona Data Visualization is a next generation data visualization and analytics system optimized for real-time and historical big data back ends. Verona allows users to create custom interactive visualizations into web applications and portals built on JavaScript libraries such as D3 and and Leaflet. 

Architecture, design and implementation of the “in line” chart editing feature of Verona Studio Web Application. This feature allowed the designer of the chart to “click” on a components of the chart and change the values. I implemented with JavaScript, D3 JSON Schema and HTML5.

Architecture, design and implementation Selenium WebDriverJS test cases for Verona Studio UI.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - IBM BlueMix
positions.description:
Developer IBM Bluemix Appreciation Coaching Evaluation (ACE) User Interface. IBM Bluemix is an open-standards (Cloud Foundry), cloud-based platform for building, managing, and running web application. 

ACE supports all major desktop and mobile web browsers. ACE employs responsive web design techniques, HTML5, CSS3, DOJO toolkit and REST web services to provide the functionality and flexibility required in mobile first environment.

Architecture, design and implementation of ACE web analytics working with the Bluemix marketing team the following tracking technologies were added: IBM Digital Analytics Google AdWord to support analysis of marketing campaigns. 

Architecture, design and implementation Mocha test cases for ACE UI.

publications.title: Tag Derived Semantic Framework for Mashup with Organic Ontologies

patents.title: Pre-highlighting text in a semantic highlighting system
patents.description: A method, computer system and/or computer program product pre-highlight text that is located in a search. A text highlight and a triple statement semantic annotation based on the text highlight of a first document are received. The triple statement semantic annotation comprises a subject, a relationship and an object. A natural language processing (NLP) pattern based on the triple statement semantic annotation is generated. The NLP pattern is representative of a linguistic pattern between the text highlight and the triple statement semantic annotation. A multi-dimensional linguistic profile is generated based on the text highlight, the triple statement semantic annotation and the NLP pattern, wherein the multi-dimensional linguistic profile defines entities, relationships and attributes associated with document text. Text in a second document is compared with the multi-dimensional linguistic profile, and text in the second document is highlighted based on the comparison.

patents.title: Creating an ontology using an online encyclopedia and tag cloud
patents.description: A method for generating an ontology may include selecting, by a processing device, a tag in a tag cloud. The method may also include searching, by the processing device, an online encyclopedia for content corresponding to the selected tag and determining, by the processing device, at least one category to which the content belongs in the online encyclopedia in response to finding the content corresponding to the selected tag in the online encyclopedia. The method may additionally include adding, by the processing device, a class to the ontology corresponding to the at least one category of the content in the online encyclopedia.
